definitions.gloss: drinking party; banquet; occasion where alcohol is served
definitions.explanation: A gathering or event where alcoholic drinks are served, ranging from formal banquets to casual drinking parties. A somewhat formal term.

examples.japanese: {酒席|しゅせき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マナー→マナー：11139_manaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: To observe proper manners at a drinking party.

examples.japanese: {酒席|しゅせき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{失言|しつげん}→失言：12189_shitsugen⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I made an unfortunate remark at the drinking party.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{酒席|しゅせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I often attend drinking parties for work-related socializing, but lately I've been declining.

notes:
Composed of {酒|しゅ} (alcohol) + ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧ (seat/occasion). A formal term for a gathering where alcohol is the central element. More elevated in register than ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酒席|しゅせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧: to arrange a drinking party
- {酒席|しゅせき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}い→振る舞い：10520_furumai⟧: behavior at a drinking gathering
- {酒席|しゅせき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{招|まね}かれる→招く：02425_maneku⟧: to be invited to a drinking party
- {酒席|しゅせき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がる→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧: to liven up at a banquet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧: drinking party — the everyday, casual term
- ⟦{宴会|えんかい}→宴会：04104_enkai⟧: banquet; party — often larger and more formal
- ⟦{宴席|えんせき}→宴席：24088_enseki⟧: banquet seat/occasion — very similar, slightly more formal
- ⟦{懇親会|こんしんかい}→懇親会：17926_konshinkai⟧: social gathering — focuses on networking and socializing
